subject: cognition/stale-subject-refinement
statement: Task-local subject-bearing assumptions and questions must surface a deterministic possible-stale signal when a later event with different text reuses the same subject or refines it hierarchically (for example foo -> foo-16gb or foo/bar). The runtime warns only; it does not silently delete, resolve, or supersede cognition.
